title: 我的一天 — My Day
summary: A student describes her daily routine: getting up, studying Chinese, and resting.

paragraphs.pinyin: wǒ jiào ānnà, wǒ shì xuésheng.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄢㄋㄚˋ, ㄨㄛˇ ㄕˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊㄕㄥ˙.
paragraphs.translation: My name is Ana, I'm a student.
paragraphs.romanization: wǒ jiào ānnà, wǒ shì xuésheng.
paragraphs.translation_en: My name is Ana, I'm a student.
paragraphs.translation_id: Nama saya Ana, saya seorang pelajar.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我七点起床，喝一杯咖啡。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng, hē yì bēi kāfēi.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄑㄧ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄑㄧˇㄔㄨㄤˊ, ㄏㄜ ㄧˋ ㄅㄟ ㄎㄚㄈㄟ.
paragraphs.translation: I get up at seven and have a coffee.
paragraphs.text: 我七点起床，喝一杯咖啡。
paragraphs.romanization: wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng, hē yì bēi kāfēi.
paragraphs.translation_en: I get up at seven and have a coffee.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya bangun jam tujuh dan minum kopi.

paragraphs.pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐhuan xué hànyǔ.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄏㄣˇ ㄒㄧˇㄏㄨㄢ˙ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄏㄢˋㄩˇ.
paragraphs.translation: I really like studying Chinese.
paragraphs.romanization: wǒ hěn xǐhuan xué hànyǔ.
paragraphs.translation_en: I really like studying Chinese.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya sangat suka belajar bahasa Mandarin.

paragraphs.hanzi: 晚上我看书，十一点睡觉。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǎnshang wǒ kàn shū, shíyī diǎn shuìjiào.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄢˇㄕㄤ˙ ㄨㄛˇ ㄎㄢˋ ㄕㄨ, ㄕˊㄧ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄕㄨㄟˋㄐㄧㄠˋ.
paragraphs.translation: At night I read and go to bed at eleven.
paragraphs.text: 晚上我看书，十一点睡觉。
paragraphs.romanization: wǎnshang wǒ kàn shū, shíyī diǎn shuìjiào.
paragraphs.translation_en: At night I read and go to bed at eleven.
paragraphs.translation_id: Malam hari saya membaca dan tidur jam sebelas.

questions.prompt: What time does Ana get up?

summary_en: A student describes her daily routine: getting up, studying Chinese, and resting.
summary_id: Seorang pelajar mendeskripsikan rutinitas hariannya: bangun, belajar bahasa Mandarin, dan istirahat.

title: 在饭店 — At the restaurant
summary: A simple conversation ordering food in a restaurant.

paragraphs.pinyin: fúwùyuán: nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào shénme?
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄈㄨˊㄨˋㄩㄢˊ: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ! ㄋㄧˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄕㄣˊㄇㄜ˙?
paragraphs.translation: Waiter: Hello! What would you like?
paragraphs.romanization: fúwùyuán: nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào shénme?
paragraphs.translation_en: Waiter: Hello! What would you like?
paragraphs.translation_id: Pelayan: Halo! Mau pesan apa?

paragraphs.pinyin: kèrén: wǒ yào mǐfàn hé chá.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄎㄦˋㄣˊ: ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄇㄧˇㄈㄢˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄔㄚˊ.
paragraphs.translation: Customer: I'd like rice and tea.
paragraphs.romanization: kèrén: wǒ yào mǐfàn hé chá.
paragraphs.translation_en: Customer: I'd like rice and tea.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pelanggan: Saya mau nasi dan teh.

paragraphs.hanzi: 服务员：好的。一共十五块。
paragraphs.pinyin: fúwùyuán: hǎo de. yígòng shíwǔ kuài.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄈㄨˊㄨˋㄩㄢˊ: ㄏㄠˇ ㄉㄜ˙. ㄧˊㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄕˊㄨˇ ㄎㄨㄞˋ.
paragraphs.translation: Waiter: Very well. Fifteen yuan total.
paragraphs.text: 服务员：好的。一共十五块。
paragraphs.romanization: fúwùyuán: hǎo de. yígòng shíwǔ kuài.
paragraphs.translation_en: Waiter: Very well. Fifteen yuan total.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pelayan: Baik. Totalnya lima belas yuan.

paragraphs.pinyin: kèrén: xièxie!
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄎㄦˋㄣˊ: ㄒㄧㄝˋㄒㄧㄝ˙!
paragraphs.translation: Customer: Thank you!
paragraphs.romanization: kèrén: xièxie!
paragraphs.translation_en: Customer: Thank you!
paragraphs.translation_id: Pelanggan: Terima kasih!

questions.prompt: How much does the food cost?

summary_en: A simple conversation ordering food in a restaurant.
summary_id: Percakapan sederhana memesan makanan di restoran.

title: 我的家 — My family
summary: Introduction of a family: parents, brother, and the pet.

paragraphs.hanzi: 我家有四个人：爸爸、妈妈、弟弟和我。
paragraphs.pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu sì ge rén: bàba, māma, dìdi hé wǒ.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄧㄡˇ ㄙˋ ㄍㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ: ㄅㄚˋㄅㄚ˙, ㄇㄚㄇㄚ˙, ㄉㄧˋㄉㄧ˙ ㄏㄜˊ ㄨㄛˇ.
paragraphs.translation: There are four people in my family: dad, mom, my younger brother, and me.
paragraphs.text: 我家有四个人：爸爸、妈妈、弟弟和我。
paragraphs.romanization: wǒ jiā yǒu sì ge rén: bàba, māma, dìdi hé wǒ.
paragraphs.translation_en: There are four people in my family: dad, mom, my younger brother, and me.
paragraphs.translation_id: Keluarga saya ada empat orang: ayah, ibu, adik laki-laki, dan saya.

paragraphs.hanzi: 爸爸是老师，妈妈是医生。
paragraphs.pinyin: bàba shì lǎoshī, māma shì yīshēng.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄅㄚˋㄅㄚ˙ ㄕˋ ㄌㄠˇㄕ, ㄇㄚㄇㄚ˙ ㄕˋ ㄧㄕㄥ.
paragraphs.translation: Dad is a teacher and mom is a doctor.
paragraphs.text: 爸爸是老师，妈妈是医生。
paragraphs.romanization: bàba shì lǎoshī, māma shì yīshēng.
paragraphs.translation_en: Dad is a teacher and mom is a doctor.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ayah seorang guru dan ibu seorang dokter.

paragraphs.pinyin: dìdi hěn xiǎo, tā liù suì.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄉㄧˋㄉㄧ˙ ㄏㄣˇ ㄒㄧㄠˇ, ㄊㄚ ㄌㄧㄡˋ ㄙㄨㄟˋ.
paragraphs.translation: My brother is little, he's six years old.
paragraphs.romanization: dìdi hěn xiǎo, tā liù suì.
paragraphs.translation_en: My brother is little, he's six years old.
paragraphs.translation_id: Adik saya masih kecil, umurnya enam tahun.

paragraphs.pinyin: wǒmen dōu hěn ài wǒmen de jiā.
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇㄇㄣ˙ ㄉㄡ ㄏㄣˇ ㄞˋ ㄨㄛˇㄇㄣ˙ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄚ.
paragraphs.translation: We all love our family very much.
paragraphs.romanization: wǒmen dōu hěn ài wǒmen de jiā.
paragraphs.translation_en: We all love our family very much.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami semua sangat sayang keluarga kami.

summary_id: Pengenalan keluarga: orang tua, saudara, dan hewan peliharaan.
